## Invariant workflow

The workflow is stable:

```text
metadata -> commands/scripts -> outputs -> report -> Git commit -> interpretation
```

The backend can vary:

- Local Docker or Podman.
- GitHub Codespaces for editing, rendering, and small downstream work.
- Galaxy demonstration.
- Instructor machine or VM.
- Checkpoint mode.

## Decision rule

Use the simplest backend that lets the student document and interpret the workflow correctly.
